method: Actual app functions, real map-catalog loader and packed source data, and AtlasMap.setYear; only rendering, DOM and I/O completion are controlled.

tests.name: Initial map becomes interactive from a date pack without reading the complete catalog
Optional geography starts only after the initial historical frame commits, with restored preferences
Every date pack preserves active records; subsequent full reading never replaces global catalog with a partial pack
A late older date catalog cannot overwrite the latest left-map request
A newer left catalog failure cancels an earlier in-flight renderer and preserves the committed year
Comparison date catalogs obey their own generation and keep the left map unchanged
A newer comparison catalog failure invalidates an earlier renderer before it can commit
Preparing another year keeps the displayed catalog until its map frame commits
Closing comparison while its catalog is pending cannot revive the removed map
Initial comparison cannot submit an old catalog under a newer year
Polity reading waits for the full catalog and receives the complete period chain
Closing a pending polity dossier prevents its later catalog from opening the reader
Changing a dossier map year rejects the obsolete reader completion
A different polity selected during catalog loading wins the reader
Dossier catalog failures display retry; retry succeeds and preserves the original selection
Search lazily reads all periods, retries failures, and renders the newest query
Search observes catalog completion even when a now-closed dossier started the shared request
Search observes failures of a shared catalog request started by another view
A polity deep link retries its full catalog after an initial download failure
Recorded-change navigation never mutates a shared date index and stays nearest in both directions
No rejected lazy catalog or obsolete callback creates an unhandled rejection
